{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''1998 United States Senate election in Ohio''' was held November 3, 1998. It was concurrent with elections to the [[United States House of Representatives]]. Incumbent Democratic U.S Senator [[John Glenn]] decided to retire, instead of seeking a fifth term. Republican Governor [[George Voinovich]] won the open seat.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/18250221/the_akron_beacon_journal/|title=Voinovich backs lengthier trial for Clinton|newspaper=The Akron Beacon Journal|date=January 6, 1999|via=[[Newspapers.com]]|page=10}}</ref>
This was the first open-seat Senate election in Ohio for this seat since [[1920 United States Senate election in Ohio|1920]].

== General election ==
=== Candidates ===
* [[Mary O. Boyle|Mary Boyle]], former [[Cuyahoga County, Ohio|Cuyahoga County]] commissioner and candidate for U.S. Senate in [[1994 United States Senate election in Ohio|1994]] (Democratic)

* [[George Voinovich]], incumbent governor of Ohio and nominee in [[1988 United States Senate election in Ohio|1988]] (Republican)
